title: A variable of a nested VAR block is not visible after the block
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR a = SUMX ( T, VAR b = T[n] RETURN b * 2 ) RETURN a + b )

expected.error: b is defined in the nested VAR/RETURN inside SUMX and does not exist in the outer RETURN

source.quote: the nested variables are not visible outside of the scope of expression
source.supports: a variable defined in a nested VAR/RETURN cannot be used outside it

derivation: b exists only inside the VAR/RETURN that is the second argument of SUMX. The outer RETURN refers to b, which is not defined there, so the query fails.
